excerpts: Question IDs are for your code. They are not sent to the model. Write the complete question in `instructions`, even when the ID seems self-explanatory.
Every question in a request sees the same state, is evaluated independently, and returns a typed answer under the ID you chose.
When a question is about one of those parts, name it in the `instructions` with a dot-and-index path to its key, including the backticks. The model then knows which part of the state to judge.
Each request evaluates one state against one or more questions. All questions see the same state and are evaluated independently.
You choose the question id, `department` in this case. The answer is returned under the same id. The model never sees the question id.
